description.en: Set net.tls.mode to requireTLS and net.tls.disabledProtocols to TLS1_0,TLS1_1,TLS1_2. Clients older than driver 4.2 cannot connect afterwards.
Rotate the server certificate and key with the rotateCertificates command; no restart is needed. The vendor suggests an interval of 90 days.
Turn on the audit log with auditLog.destination: file and ship it off the host.
